item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/blog/retiring-estimator-quoting-knowledge","version_id":"7684d3f81b48f399e04d30dd15d5c9125d3b3466ed41c07228ed6dc7b4631cc7","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, dated commercial evidence about AI-assisted manufacturing quoting: Cableteque says its system checks connector and wire compatibility, maps part numbers, compares distributor prices, and auto-fills 60–80% of a labor template. It is relevant to production-ready design decisions because it addresses whether incomplete drawings, compatible components, and labor assumptions are captured before a quote reaches the shop floor. The reported 70% turnaround reduction and fivefold capacity estimate are a customer-attributed case study, not independently verified performance; the item does not disclose job mix, attempt counts, or an external comparison, so those claims require a reproducible before/after audit. It adds a startup/commercial perspective and supports what the company says it ships, while its proposed checks illustrate what a buyer should validate.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
